content:
Parameter
Required?
Description
policy_key
Required
The identifier for an existing policy to
be copied: 20 alphanumeric characters
starting with PO , or global  as a
shortcut for the global policy.
new_policy_names_list
Optional
An array of policy names. The policy
specified by policy_key  will be
copied once for each name in the list,
and the resulting new policy will be
given that name.
